message: WebDataBinder: class.module.classLoader accessed via DataBinder parameter binding (CVE-2022-22965). Attacker set class.module.classLoader.resources.context.parent.pipeline.first.pattern=%%{c2}i_%%{c1}i_spring_shell payload. Spring4Shell exploit via Tomcat logging configuration. JDK 9+, Tomcat WAR deployment confirmed.

DataBinder allowed binding of class.classLoader property chain, exposing ClassLoader to attacker control. Tomcat access log pattern overwritten. spring-webmvc 5.3.16 on JDK 17 — vulnerable to Spring4Shell (CVE-2022-22965). Upgrade to 5.3.18 (fix commit 002546b3) required.

ThreatMonitor: Spring4Shell exploit attempt detected on POST /api/upload. WebDataBinder class.module.classLoader parameter injection. 234 requests from 203.0.113.0/24. api-svc deployed as WAR on Tomcat 9.0.60 with JDK 17 — confirmed Spring4Shell attack surface.
Spring Framework patched to 5.3.18. WebDataBinder now blocks class.classLoader access via disallowed field patterns. CVE-2022-22965 mitigated. Fix commit 002546b3 applied.
